title: 面向操作的错误分类与用户恢复建议
summary: 将底层日志与异常模式归入稳定错误类别，并为每类错误提供原因、恢复动作与成品是否仍可保存等语义，而不是直接把原始错误文本当产品反馈。
principles: Preserve raw evidence while presenting a stable user-facing category.
Separate failure cause from recommended recovery action.
Represent whether a usable output may still exist after a secondary audit failure.
Unknown failures remain unknown categories rather than being misclassified.
